source.title: Valiant Hammer — Wowhead firsthand disenchant comment
source.author: Senkrads

quote: Disenchanting it provided two Resonant Crystals.
notes: Original firsthand single-item Mystic disenchant. One explicitly completed operation produced two crystals; this event does not establish any general chance, exclusivity, or current-build yield.
